summary: George Russell won the Azerbaijan Grand Prix from pole position, 0.2s ahead of Max Verstappen, with Isack Hadjar completing the podium.
Kimi Antonelli made the biggest climb, from P16 to P5.
Oscar Piastri had a day to forget, dropping from P3 to P13.
The race was neutralised by 2 safety cars.
The stewards penalised COL (10 second time penalty).
There were 36 pit stops in total; the winner stopped 2 times.
Kimi Antonelli leads the championship by 66 points over George Russell.
